description: This file defines a class `_PROXY_MaxParallelRequestsHandler` that manages rate limiting and request concurrency control for a proxy server, specifically handling parallel requests, logging, and updating rate limit usage metrics with caching. It includes asynchronous hooks for pre- and post-request processing, as well as error handling related to rate limits.

classes.name: _PROXY_MaxParallelRequestsHandler
classes.description: A class that handles maximum parallel requests and rate limiting logic, including cache management, logging, and error handling for rate limit breaches within a proxy server context.
